about: Decisions and notes from maker documents read after the research pass. Oct 9: True North's June 2026 wood brochure (31900010, uploaded by Ben; its values were already in specs_raw from the research pass). Ben, Oct 9: where True North's website shows one 'Log Size (max.)' that equals the manual's ideal length, record both lengths (recommended and max) and keep the difference noted.

true-north-tn10-wood-stove.log_length_max_in: Catalog now shows 12 in. recommended, 14 in. max. The website labels its 12 in. as 'Log Size (max.)'; the manual (14 in. max, 12 in. ideal) and the June 2026 brochure (12 in. recommended, 14 in. max) give both.

true-north-tn20-wood-stove.btu_output_cordwood_max: The June 2026 brochure agrees with the manual: 55,000 BTU (p. 2). The TN20 insert page, same firebox and EPA test, also says 55,000.
true-north-tn20-wood-stove.log_length_max_in: Catalog now shows 18 in. recommended, 20 in. max. The website labels its 18 in. as 'Log Size (max.)'; the manual (20 in. max, 18 in. ideal) and the June 2026 brochure (18 in. recommended, 20 in. max) give both.

true-north-tn20-wood-insert.log_length_max_in: Catalog now shows 18 in. recommended, 20 in. max. The website labels its 18 in. as 'Log Size (max.)'; the manual (20 in. max, 18 in. ideal) and the June 2026 brochure (18 in. recommended, 20 in. max) give both.

true-north-tn25c-wood-stove.log_length_max_in: Catalog now shows 18 in. recommended, 20 in. max. The website and the TN25c brochure (Oct 2025) label 18 in. as max; the manual gives 20 in. max and 18 in. ideal.
true-north-tn25c-wood-stove.btu_output_min: The TN25c brochure (Oct 2025) gives a third figure, 13,450 BTU. The website's 13,900 is the TN20's EPA low figure.

true-north-tn10-wood-stove.log_length_max_in: recorded both (Ben, Oct 9): the website's figure as the recommended length, the manual's as the maximum
